Hey first-time homebuyers! 🏠✨
Becoming a homeowner comes with some 𝘀𝗲𝗿𝗶𝗼𝘂𝘀 𝘁𝗮𝘅 𝗽𝗲𝗿𝗸𝘀 — and knowing them can save you big every year. 💸
Here are 𝟱 𝗺𝘂𝘀𝘁-𝗸𝗻𝗼𝘄 𝘁𝗮𝘅 𝗯𝗲𝗻𝗲𝗳𝗶𝘁𝘀 for new homeowners:

✨ 𝗠𝗼𝗿𝘁𝗴𝗮𝗴𝗲 𝗜𝗻𝘁𝗲𝗿𝗲𝘀𝘁 𝗗𝗲𝗱𝘂𝗰𝘁𝗶𝗼𝗻
One of the biggest advantages of owning a home. This can reduce your taxable income significantly.

✨ 𝗣𝗿𝗼𝗽𝗲𝗿𝘁𝘆 𝗧𝗮𝘅 𝗗𝗲𝗱𝘂𝗰𝘁𝗶𝗼𝗻
State & local property taxes may be deductible — a major benefit for Texas homeowners.

✨ 𝗛𝗼𝗺𝗲 𝗜𝗺𝗽𝗿𝗼𝘃𝗲𝗺𝗲𝗻𝘁 𝗕𝗲𝗻𝗲𝗳𝗶𝘁𝘀
Some upgrades may qualify for 𝘁𝗮𝘅 𝗰𝗿𝗲𝗱𝗶𝘁𝘀, especially energy-efficient improvements.

✨ 𝗛𝗼𝗺𝗲 𝗢𝗳𝗳𝗶𝗰𝗲 𝗗𝗲𝗱𝘂𝗰𝘁𝗶𝗼𝗻
If you work from home, you may be able to deduct a portion of your home expenses (if it meets IRS requirements).

✨ 𝗠𝗼𝘃𝗶𝗻𝗴 𝗘𝘅𝗽𝗲𝗻𝘀𝗲𝘀 (𝗦𝗽𝗲𝗰𝗶𝗮𝗹 𝗖𝗮𝘀𝗲𝘀)
Some military-related moves (PCS) may still qualify — huge for Central Texas families. 🇺🇸

Every situation is different, so talking with a tax professional is always a smart move.
Homeownership isn’t just a milestone — 𝗶𝘁’𝘀 𝗮𝗻 𝗶𝗻𝘃𝗲𝘀𝘁𝗺𝗲𝗻𝘁 𝘁𝗵𝗮𝘁 𝗽𝗮𝘆𝘀 𝘆𝗼𝘂 𝗯𝗮𝗰𝗸. 💼📊
